solution: Using cosine rule to get \(\cos A, \cos B, \cos C\) and then cotangents, the expression evaluates to \(\frac{2b^2}{c^2+a^2-b^2} = \frac{2(4)^2}{23+3^2-4^2} = \frac{32}{16} = 2\). Matches option B.
note: denominator printed 2sqrt3^2 + 3^2 - 4^2; with c^2 = 23 it is 23 + 9 - 16 = 16. Key B unchanged.

solution: Let the sides be \(a\) and \(b=2a\), so \(B=A+60^\circ\). By the sine rule, \(\sin B=2\sin A\): \(\sin(A+60^\circ)=2\sin A\Rightarrow\frac{1}{2}\sin A+\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cos A=2\sin A\Rightarrow\tan A=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\), so \(A=30^\circ\) and \(B=90^\circ\). The triangle is right-angled. Matches option B.
note: concluded cot A = 0, A = 90 degrees; in fact tan A = 1/sqrt3, A = 30 degrees and the right angle is B. Key B unchanged.

solution: \(\tan(\pi\cos\theta)=\cot(\pi\sin\theta)\Rightarrow \cos(\pi\cos\theta+\pi\sin\theta)=0\), so \(\pi(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)=\frac{\pi}{2}+n\pi\). Since \(|\cos\theta+\sin\theta|\le\sqrt{2}\), \(\cos\theta+\sin\theta=\pm\frac{1}{2}\), i.e. \(\sqrt2\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\theta\right)=\pm\frac12\) and \(\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\theta\right)=\pm\frac{1}{2\sqrt2}\). Of these, the options offer \(\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\): option D.
note: took only n = 0; n = -1 also gives cos + sin = -1/2, so the value is +-1/(2 sqrt2), of which the options offer the positive one. Key D unchanged.

solution: S1: with \(|z|=1\), \(\frac{z-i}{z+i}\) is real when it equals its conjugate \(\frac{\overline{z}+i}{\overline{z}-i}\), i.e. \((z-i)(\overline{z}-i)=(z+i)(\overline{z}+i)\), which gives \(z+\overline{z}=0\): \(z=\pm i\). As \(z\ne -i\), only \(z=i\) remains, so the set has one element and S1 is false. S2: \(\frac{z-1}{z+1}\) is purely imaginary when \(\frac{z-1}{z+1}+\frac{\overline{z}-1}{\overline{z}+1}=0\), i.e. \(2|z|^{2}-2=0\), which holds for every \(z\) with \(|z|=1\), \(z\ne-1\): infinitely many, so S2 is true. Only (S2) is correct.
note: said z + conj(z) = 0 gives z = 0 (so 'no element'); it gives z = +-i, and with -i excluded S1 has one element. Rewrote both parts cleanly. Key C unchanged.
